reasoning: 驗證目標：已設定 traffic city ID 時，收音機在背景持續掃描各頻道 PID 欄位比對該 city ID 並錄下最新的交通與天氣播送；當該 city ID 有播送可用時，Traffic & Weather 鍵依 HMI 定義highlight。為什麼這樣切：「持續」「背景」「錄製」皆非可直接觀察，其可觀察後果是——使用者未操作、且不在該頻道上時，按鍵狀態仍會隨播送可用與否改變；故程序全程不觸碰 HU，於播送前後各讀一次按鍵狀態。highlight 的樣式屬 HMI 定義，ER 只斷言其狀態改變而不指定外觀（§8.4.2）。[A-SX03]。錄製內容的可用性由 157 的重播驗證（§8.2.1）。

tcs.tc_title: The Traffic and Weather button follows availability without user action
tcs.test_item: If a traffic city ID has been set, the HU shall continuously scan all channels for a matching city ID in the PID field and record the latest traffic & weather feed in the background, and when a traffic/weather broadcast is available for the traffic city ID the Traffic & Weather button shall be highlighted
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. A traffic city ID is set for the Jump function
5. No traffic and weather broadcast is available for that city ID at the start of the test
6. A broadcast for that city ID will become available during the test
7. The HU is tuned to a channel that is not the traffic and weather channel
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the state of the Traffic & Weather button and leave the HU untouched
2. Wait until a traffic and weather broadcast becomes available for the set city ID
3. Read the state of the Traffic & Weather button without operating the HU
4. Read the tuned channel
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Traffic & Weather button is not highlighted
2. A broadcast is available for the set city ID
3. The Traffic & Weather button is highlighted
4. The tuned channel is unchanged, the button state having followed the broadcast without any user action
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
